statement.excerpt: By my count (helped considerably by my sharp-eyed followers on X), there are at least ten ways, many subtle, in which the image neither matches the prompt nor what we would expect from the world.

from_speaker: neither matches the prompt nor what we would expect from the world
our_interpretation: Count distinct, defensible discrepancies in the particular image published with the post.
A discrepancy may concern either prompt adherence or ordinary physical expectations. Allow the explicitly fictional unicorn premise.
Do not automatically count multiple descriptions of the same defect separately. Artistic choices require justification before counting them as errors.
The target is the image as published on January 29, 2024; its generation date is unspecified.
criteria.support_condition: Inspection of an authenticated image and its complete prompt establishes at least ten distinct discrepancies under the stated counting rules.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A sufficiently complete independent audit establishes fewer than ten defensible discrepancies. Merely failing to identify ten is insufficient.
